appInfo.name: Metal
appInfo.subtitle: Text your team of AI bots

version.description:
Metal is your own team of AI bots, and this app puts them in your pocket.

Your bots run on your computer or server, where they do real work: read and answer email, book things, keep an eye on
your site, run your routines. This app is how you stay in touch with them when you are away from your desk.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Text any bot like a teammate and read its reply the moment it lands
- Put a few bots in one room and let them split the work
- Say yes or no when a bot asks before it does something that matters
- Get a notification when a bot finishes or needs you
- See your routines and switch them on or off
- Keep writing with no signal: messages wait and send once you are back
- Start a new bot from your phone

HOW IT WORKS
Pair the app once by scanning the code Metal shows on your computer, or sign in to your Dusk Cloud account. From then on
your phone talks to your bots directly, or through an end-to-end encrypted link when you are away.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No ads, no tracking, no analytics
- Your chats stay with your bots, not on our servers
- Your pairing is kept in the iPhone Keychain

You choose which AI your bots use, on your computer. Before anything you write goes to an AI provider, the app tells you
who receives it and asks you first.
version.promotionalText: Your AI bots keep working on your computer while you are out. Text them, approve what matters, and get a ping when the work is done.
version.whatsNew: A smoother chat: the keyboard and messages move together. Swipe a message to reply to it. Connect apps right from your phone. Talk to your bot in a voice call. Open code, pictures, tables and PDFs full screen. A more reliable connection when you switch networks or come back to the app.

reviewNotes:
WHAT THE APP IS
Metal for iPhone is free, with no in-app purchases. It is the remote control for a person's own AI bots. The bots run on the person's own computer or server, or on a Dusk Cloud computer hosted by Dusk Bot, and do their work there. The phone sends messages to those bots, shows their replies and lets the person approve actions. Nothing runs on the phone except the interface, which is bundled in the app (no web content is loaded from a server).

Pairing your own computer needs no account: the first screen offers "Scan a QR code" and "Enter a code". Only a dusk cloud needs sign-in, through the "Have a dusk cloud? Log in" link. The demo account below has a dusk cloud with a ready demo bot called Sunny, so you can use everything without a computer of your own.

DEMO ACCOUNT
Email: [REVIEW EMAIL]
Sign-in code: [REVIEW CODE, 8 digits, fixed for this account; no email is sent]

STEPS
1. Launch the app and tap "Have a dusk cloud? Log in" at the bottom.
2. Enter the review email, tap "Send code", enter the code above and tap "Sign in". The app opens "Demo Cloud" (if it shows "Pick a cloud", tap "Demo Cloud").
3. The home screen shows "Metal" (pinned) and "Sunny". Tap Sunny to open the chat.
4. Type a message, for example "Give me three ideas for a quick dinner", and send it.
5. Before the first message goes out, the app shows "Before you chat": who receives what you write (the computer running the bots, the AI they use, connected apps, our relay). Tap "Allow". "Not now" keeps the app usable for reading and settings.
6. Sunny replies within a few seconds. If the cloud computer was asleep after a long idle time, the first reply can take up to a minute while it wakes.
7. Long-press a reply and tap "Report this reply" to report it.
8. Tap the profile button (top left) for Settings: appearance, notifications, privacy policy, terms, help and "Contact us".
9. Account deletion: open Settings, scroll to the bottom, tap "Delete account", then "Delete my account". It deletes the account right away and revokes Sign in with Apple. Please try this last: it removes the demo account and its cloud from the app.

NATIVE FEATURES
Camera QR pairing (our own AVFoundation scanner), Keychain storage of the pairing, Sign in with Apple in the system sheet, dictation (speech recognition runs on the iPhone where supported), push notifications for replies and approvals, haptics, the system share sheet, an offline outbox that sends when the connection returns, and a local network connection to the person's own computer on the same Wi-Fi.

NOTES
- Purchases (3.1.1): the app is free, sells nothing, and shows no prices, plans, upgrade buttons or links to buy. dusk cloud is not on sale today (our website has a waitlist). The demo account's cloud was set up by us at no cost.
- Sign-in (4.8): where Google or X sign-in is offered, Sign in with Apple is offered first. Email with a one-time code always works.
- Permissions: camera only for the pairing QR code and photos you choose to attach; microphone and speech recognition only while you dictate a message or talk with a bot on a call; local network only to reach your own computer.
- AI (5.1.2): replies come from the AI provider connected where the bots run (for the demo cloud, a DeepSeek model through OpenRouter, paid by us). The app asks before anything is sent and names who receives it.
- Chats are private to the person; there is no public or person-to-person content.
